this_title: Notre-Dame de Paris, le chantier du siècle Season 1
introduction: How do you reconstruct an 800-year old monument, when no-one knows how it was originally built? At the heart of the worksite over 200 experts share with the architects the common objective of uncovering the secrets of its structure, to successfully return its soul, light and sacred quality to this unique cathedral. This magnificent series offers a unique immersion of astonishing beauty into the largest restoration project of the century, alongside workers, architects, historians and scientists who are struggling to bring it back to life.Episodes:1. Wounded Stone2. A House of Cards3. Rebuilding the InvisibleCo-produced by Arte France, ZED, CNRS, Inrap, ÉPND - 2022 with the participation of the Cité de l'architecture et du patrimoine, Musée des Monuments français, PLANÈTE+ and NHK.
